ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes are dominated by high-intensity white pixels. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and tips, with a dense concentration at the peduncle insertion. Two distinct mid-lobe regions exhibit low-contrast yellowish-tan pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and a depth of approximately 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations (peaks and valleys) at distal tips. Moderate-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities along the mid-trailing edge. Smoother linear boundary approaching the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex trailing edge with a steep upward curve towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, dark high-contrast spots located on the upper distal quadrant of the right lobe and smaller clusters near the left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark) visible in the lower-right lobe quadrant. Multiple smaller, diagonal unaligned scratches across the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular chipping and jagged edges at the fluke tips. Large, irregular low-intensity black marking at the base of the notch/peduncle area.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical yellowish-tan diatom staining across the central mid-sections of both lobes.
